regulatory_framework: Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI) Code for Self-Regulation
chapter: Chapter I: For Truthful and Honest Representations
legal_nexus: Consumer Protection Act 2019 / Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements 2022

rules.regulatory_justification: Under Clause 1.4, advertisements must not make comparative pricing or market-wide cost superiority claims unless substantiated by comprehensive, contemporaneous third-party market price audits across all relevant competitors and tier configurations.
compliant_alternatives: engineered for optimal total cost of ownership (TCO)
rules.actionable_guidance: Replace superlative absolute pricing claims with verifiable relative descriptions, or cite audited pricing studies with published date and methodology.

rules.clause_reference: ASCI Chapter I, Clause 1.1 & 1.5; Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act 1954
rules.regulatory_justification: Clause 1.1 strictly forbids deceptive, misleading, or scientifically unproven health, wellness, and medical efficacy guarantees. Absolute claims of 'cure' violate statutory consumer protection mandates and require double-blind peer-reviewed clinical validation approved by statutory regulatory bodies.
compliant_alternatives: scientifically formulated to support management of
demonstrated supportive efficacy in clinical trials
rules.actionable_guidance: Never use the word 'cure' or absolute guarantees for medical or therapeutic outcomes. Frame results in terms of clinically measured indicators.

rules.regulatory_justification: Clause 1.2 prohibits exaggerated or absolutist representations that distort technical realities or lead consumers to assume impossible guarantees of zero failure or total immunity from operational disruptions.
compliant_alternatives: rigorously tested against mission-critical edge cases
rules.actionable_guidance: Replace 100% or absolute claims with precise statistical availability metrics backed by formal SLAs and test benchmarks.

rules.regulatory_justification: Clause 1.4 restricts claims of absolute market dominance or invulnerability against competitors without published comparative evidence that is verifiable by independent testing authorities.
compliant_alternatives: engineered to surpass standard workload thresholds
rules.actionable_guidance: Quantify performance using benchmark test results and formal metrics rather than unprovable superlatives.

rules.regulatory_justification: Clause 1.2 penalizes hyperbolic puffery in commercial communications that misleads buyers on the actual incremental nature of technical or product updates.
rules.actionable_guidance: Highlight specific novel technical features or measurable performance improvements rather than emotional hyperbole.

rules.regulatory_justification: Under Clause 1.3, guarantees must clearly disclose all material terms, limitations, preconditions, and dispute mechanisms rather than offering blank unconditional promises.
compliant_alternatives: subject to defined deployment criteria and enterprise agreements
backed by measurable Service Level Commitments
rules.actionable_guidance: Always attach explicit SLA terms, reference clauses, and operational prerequisites to guarantee statements.
